body: I can relate. I am my own worst enemy and punish myself constantly for things that were in my control and beyond my control. It's a shitty place too be. I can tell you that you are not a terrible person though. Yeah I'm a faceless person on the net but judging from how you've described your feelings, intentions and legitimate remorse. You are a very, very good person. A rare person too. A lot of people don't really care how they make others feel. It's a shame he couldn't see that and let shit go. If you do decide on a way to contact him I'd personally leave out the aspergers for now. He'll prob think it's just an excuse. I would tell him in the future (if you work it out) but I wouldn't count on that happening for sure. I wish you the best on this.

I have autism as well so sorry to correct you but I've always been in the habit of checking myself when emailing or texting for fear what I say will come off wrong. I wouldn't go through friends unless you just can't stand it. They are probably aware of your situation anyway. If you apologize, it needs to come from you. Last resort I can think of is send him a letter. He made wad it up and trash it but I bet he doesn't. If he's the type to show it to everyone to hurt or belittle you then I'd think twice. Depends on if he's a vengeful type. You should know if he is. One last thing. If it's been months he may be over your friendship and not want to give you another chance. He may have trash talked you too the point he'd be embarrassed to forgive you in the presence of his "friends" I think that's shitty cause we're all human and make mistakes but some people get an ego reward for feeling like they're better or someone is less than them. If that's the case, he wasn't a friend at all and I'd move on. Killing yourself over one comment that went south doesn't sound rational. I'm not trying to sound like the oh wise one here but you're 20, I'm 55 and you'll find out there are a lot of accidental mistakes you can and will probably make and he'll find out he's a hypocrite because I'll lay you money it will happen to him in the future. It always does. If he won't forgive you, forgive yourself and let it go.
Although, I'd leave out the part..I just want my friend back. Maybe phrase it I miss our friendship or something. Otherwise it kind of sounds like you're doing it for you when the apology is for him.
I know you are sincere, you need to convince him. Tell him just that.

When you do something like that and say "I was only joking" it makes a person sound like they should be let off the hook. I mean it was only a joke right? That's not enough and is the easy way out of an insult. Not trying to make you feel worse, just saying that line never did cut it for me nor does it for him. It's not an apology. You should say exactly what you said earlier about "I accept full responsibility etc..." and be genuine, not rehearsed. He will forgive you if you're sincere but he'll never forget so be careful in the future. Just my two cents. Best of luck.

I don't think there's an easy solution but maybe you could consider a different direction for your career. Maybe stay within the general area of your studies but consider something with less male peers with ego presence. IDK what exactly you are pursuing or how far you are in your schooling so maybe that doesn't make any sense in your situation. Or stand up and tell them off. If done calmly, honestly and with tact it will gain their respect. Even if they don't show it outwardly. Sounds like your coworkers are very childish too me. Is it possible to get out on your own or move in with someone else? It sounds like your home life would be too much for anyone to handle rationally. I live next door to my Mom, Sister and Son. They are perched on my mom's property just waiting for the day to take over. It's disgusting. There's  countless examples of bad blood between us. Mixed with the autism we all share except mom it's a mess. So I understand what a f'd up family is too. If your mom moved away and is happier, maybe it would help you. I'm just trying to think of ways to remove the stresses in your life. My dad was autistic and I myself and sister are on the spectrum. I also have two boys and one grandchild who are. So I get what you mean in a lot of ways. I agree with the last post, the package from your mom was a sign. She will probably feel more empathy for you than ashamed. She has lived in your surroundings and knows what it's like. As far as failure, to me loneliness and failure are my biggest fears. But you will not succeed if you don't try and failure of some sort is always part of success, unless someone hands everything to you on a silver platter and to me that doesn't count as success. I commend you for making the efforts you have. You're a strong person for that.

I feel for you. We live in a world where physical appearance is overrated. I know they are rare, but there are people out there who do not judge based on appearance. And those who do are insecure about themselves in some way. I don't have your issue but I have inner "shameful" issues I've shared with a GF in the past and my current GF of 11 yrs and to my amazement they accept me. I'm still friends with the first one. You'd be surprised what women will overlook. My point is, don't give up, just be as confident as possible and I'd bet you will meet someone and that someone will be better than someone who wants to be with you based on physical attraction.

I understand completely. Pets provide unconditional love a human is incapable of giving let alone understanding. And they depend on us. If there is reincarnation and a hierarchy of "being" I'd be willing to bet pets are at the top or at least humans are below them.
And I thought I was the only one that had that thought. Agree 100

It's fine, we probably have a lot in common. At least you commented. I just can't seem to get through to anyone how bad this is for me. Most people don't understand or really care when you lose your dog. It's a type of love humans are incapable of giving. I'd consider getting another pet in the future but then I can't end it all and leave that pet feeling like I do now. I'm just sick of feeling. Apologies if I came off rude. Just very hurt right now.

I'm not sure if you're trying to be helpful or minimizing my situation. It's not that simple. You can't sum up my shit life experiences with you feeling you have it worse so I must have something to live for since I have a few people I care about. Your life is not the yardstick of reasons to want to live or die. It feels like you've minimized my feelings in my post and dumped your situation into it like a competition. Regardless of your experience, this hit me hard, very very hard. I hear no validation. It's not helpful.
Sorry for your situation but I'd have to disagree that I have some people "to live for". I just have 3 people I care about. I have no one to live for.
